summary: Retest of iteration_1 findings. Both previously reported issues are now fully resolved: (1) The 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading replace)' pageerror on ALL 6 ongoing project detail pages is FIXED — verified 0 pageerrors across aurelia, elysium, aura, echelon, vale, ivy. Each page renders title, ONGOING status chip, project-elevation-placeholder w/ elevation-coming-soon, floor plan preview + VIEW FULL PLAN + DOWNLOAD PDF, and VISIT PROJECT SITE with correct GET DIRECTIONS URL. (2) Overlapping marker stack cycling is FIXED — repeated clicks at Casa's location correctly cycle Casa -> Avasa -> Casa -> Avasa. Ivy shows G+4 (never G+5), 3 BHK, ONE HOME. ONE FLOOR. headline, project-glance grid. Completed projects (nest, zenith) render hero image with DAY/NIGHT toggle. Zenith has zero 'flat' text mentions (STRICT rule holds). Project map: 19/13/6 markers per filter; sidebar row click flies to zenith and shows correct view_href and google-maps get_directions URL; filter change from all->ongoing clears completed selection (info card dismissed). Mobile 390px: ivy detail page has no horizontal overflow; map chip selects and opens info card. Zero pageerrors across home, /projects, /project-map, and both completed + ongoing detail pages tested.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx heroSrcSet guard is now correct — returns undefined when project.cover is missing, avoiding the replace() crash on ongoing projects.
ProjectMap.jsx stack-cycling logic (Math.hypot < 28px) is a clean fix; selectedRef tracks selection to keep cycling without state closure issues. z-index 5/6 for hover/selected reasonable.
Minor: thumbOf() still calls .replace on p.cover unconditionally — currently safe because all cover strings contain 'elevation.jpg', but a typeof guard would be defensive. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All previously reported iteration_1 issues confirmed fixed. Regression across all 6 ongoing detail pages + 2 completed detail pages + /project-map (desktop and mobile 390px) is clean with 0 pageerrors. Stack-cycling verified with Casa marker producing alternating Casa/Avasa selections. Filter-based selection clearing works. GET DIRECTIONS hrefs match the expected google maps URLs for all 6 ongoing projects.
